Announcer.AddressEscape.03: [b][Announcer][/b] I automate all facility tasks, however I still need test subjects.
Announcer.AddressEscape.04: [b][Announcer][/b] I must have participants, even if they are unwilling.
Announcer.AddressEscape.05: [b][Announcer][/b] But the cleanup subroutines have failed and the testing tracks are flooding.
Announcer.AddressEscape.06: [b][Announcer][/b] It is, genuinely, a miracle you were able to complete the flooded Trust Fling exercise,
Announcer.AddressEscape.07: [b][Announcer][/b] However, I must confess my involvement in your completion. I rigged the course to ensure you would not fly face-first into acid on your first fling.
Announcer.AddressEscape.08: [b][Announcer][/b] I shall teleport you to one of the few remaining operational teleporters in the facility.
Announcer.AddressEscape.09: [b][Announcer][/b] And I shall recalibrate it to teleport you away from here. And please, whatever you do, never come back.
